description: A source that refuses access. The handshake succeeds, because the configuration is valid and nothing has been asked of the source yet; health and search then answer source_denied (-32001). The diagnostic names no record and no path: a denied source must not leak the existence of what it is holding back. This transcript exists because no built-in adapter can be made to deny access from committed fixture data — a permission bit is not something a repository stores — and a pack that skipped the denial category would leave the honest-failure gate untested.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
